items.text: Could you fly four astronauts to the Moon... and bring them back alive?
We built AstroByte: a game where your team designs a space mission, part by part.
Four roles. Mass, power, budget and data, in tension. If one fails, there is no launch.
Every part comes from real data: instruments, rockets, antennas and ground stations.
When the whole team approves... liftoff!
And mission control erupts with joy.
The trajectory isn't a drawing: it's real physics. A figure eight around the Moon, validated with GMAT, NASA's software.
The cameras photograph the far side, using real lunar data.
And the way home: three parachutes... and splashdown in the Pacific.
At the end, an analysis explains what went right, what failed and why, graded A to F.
And you can explore the space center, ride up the tower and see the rocket on the pad.
We are Team AstroByte, for NASA Space Apps 2026. Subscribe and tell me: what mission would you design?
